bear_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 normalized EPS of USD 5.00 receives a 21x multiple if a mega-project is delayed or cancelled, gross margin normalizes toward the mid-20s, industrial mix weakens and concentration compresses the premium.
base_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 normalized EPS of USD 6.25 receives a 28.8x multiple as backlog converts on schedule, gross margin remains in the high 20s, data-center demand broadens moderately and capacity execution remains controlled.
bull_assumptions: Fiscal-2027 normalized EPS of USD 7.50 receives a 36x multiple if data-center and utility awards broaden, new capacity scales without working-capital stress, cash conversion remains strong and margins stay near recent highs.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade to Buy if price reaches the USD 144 buy-below level with the thesis intact, or new primary evidence raises normalized base value enough to create at least 20% upside without multiple expansion. Downgrade to Avoid if the major data-center project is cancelled or delayed, orders fail to broaden, backlog or book-to-bill breaks, gross margin stays below 25%, cash conversion reverses, project losses or capacity overruns emerge, debt rises materially, or the price increases without higher normalized earnings.
